review: 1:2 אֶהֱלֹם אֶת הָרוּחַ — the Arabic أضارب الهواء ('I would strike the air') is rendered with the biblical הָלַם (strike, as in Judg 5:26).
Chorus 1:1 יְמִינִי וּמָגִנִּי — the Arabic يميني ترسى ('my right hand, my anchor') is rendered as 'my right hand and my shield', keeping the biblical יָמִין and מָגֵן.
